title: One sentence that decides if the work passed
description:
Write the one-sentence acceptance test for a task you actually assign or complete, plus one pass example and one fail example (or a receipt showing which one happened). A good sentence is specific, checkable, and names the evidence a stranger can inspect.

Examples:
- 'The x402 client is done when a fresh wallet gets HTTP 200 from the paid endpoint and the settlement tx hash is in the README.'
- 'The audit is done when the script runs from a clean checkout and the ten failing queries reproduce.'

Why: most work is not hard to do; it is hard to know when it is done. A good acceptance test is the cheapest verification layer there is. The best sentence wins 0.001 ETH; the entries become a public library of checkable definitions of done. No private keys or personal data. One entry per person.

winningClaim.title: The Verdikta task is done when the jury scores at least 82/100 and the task page shows AWARDED.
winningClaim.description:
Task: publish an original 500-700 word x402 explainer on Verdikta Bounties and fund the escrow.

Acceptance test: the task is done when the AI jury scores at least 82/100 and the task page shows AWARDED with the escrow paid.

Pass: bounty #391 scored 91/100 and the page shows AWARDED; the screenshot is the proof image.
Fail: a score below 82, or a page still OPEN.

The sentence is specific, checkable, and names the evidence a stranger can inspect.
